zh-CN.title: 以工单串联审查与验证的 AI 编码工作流。
zh-CN.description: ICODE 为 Claude Code、Codex 与 CodeBuddy 提供工单驱动的 AI 编码工作流：分步设计、自行换模型后的代码审查、证据化验证与断点续接。
zh-CN.eyebrow: Claude Code · Codex · CodeBuddy 开源工作流
zh-CN.intro: 把需求、设计决策、代码变更与验证证据保存在同一条工单流程中。从计划到交付逐步推进，中断后核对状态再续接，也可通过本地 UI 管理工单。
zh-CN.flow_intro: 先明确边界，再推进实现。展开任一步，了解它接收什么、留下什么，以及继续前要检查什么。
zh-CN.optional_title: 按需使用，不是额外必经步骤
zh-CN.principles_label: 了解 ICODE 如何保护工作边界
zh-CN.illustration_label: 通用流程示意 · 非实际运行
zh-CN.delivery_title: 交付的不只是代码，还有判断依据
zh-CN.delivery_note: 通用计算器示例，人工编写，仅说明产物如何组织；不是实际工单或本次测试结果。报告存在不代表设备已验证。

stages.purpose: 把想法变成可检查的实现方案。
stages.checkpoint: 明确不做什么、风险在哪里；仅设计请求在此停止。

stages.purpose: 在动手前找出设计的缺口。
stages.input: 计划与相关源码、接口合同。
stages.checkpoint: 让建议能追溯到设计或代码依据，不凭印象放行。

stages.purpose: 把审查意见收敛成实施依据。
stages.input: 计划、审查意见与已确认取舍。
stages.checkpoint: 未决问题与范围变更要处理或明确保留。

stages.purpose: 按定稿实施，让修改与计划对应。
stages.input: 定稿方案与当前代码基线。
stages.output: 源码修改、测试与实际执行记录。
stages.checkpoint: 遵守授权范围，记录执行结果；不能把计划当完成。

stages.purpose: 回看实现与相关调用链，查漏补缺。
stages.input: 源码变更、设计依据与执行记录。
stages.checkpoint: 检查边界、回归和证据缺口；发现问题先修复复测。

stages.purpose: 核对交付结论有没有证据支撑。
stages.input: 设计、代码变更和已有验证证据。
stages.checkpoint: 区分已验证、待验证与阻塞，不把报告等同设备实测。

paths.title: 可选前置 · init / log
paths.body: 复杂需求先整理，日志问题先核对设备与源码版本；按任务选择入口，不必强行经过所有命令。

paths.title: 独立验证 · verify
paths.body: 显式选择编译、部署、监听或测试，可独立或组合执行。只监听、测试时直接使用设备现有版本，不隐式编译或部署。

paths.title: 高级可选复评 · crosscheck
paths.body: 仅对已完成工单独立复评。可自行换 Agent 或模型，多轮结果单独保存；不改原工单历史或代码，不自动切换模型。

scenes.title: 01 / 开发与设计
scenes.body: 工单驱动开发，也可以只要方案。把目标和停止点一起告诉 Agent。
scenes.command: 使用 ICODE 给这个模块增加重试，先出方案，不改代码。
scenes.more:
/icode start 给计算器增加取模功能并补充测试
/icode plan
scenes.note: start 串联主线，plan 可单步使用；明确“只设计”时不得越过停止点。

scenes.title: 02 / 日志与排障
scenes.body: 先确认版本、时间窗口和证据来源，再分析异常与可能原因。
scenes.command: 使用 ICODE 分析这份异常日志，先定位原因，不修改代码。
scenes.note: 当前源码、部署版本、历史日志不是同一层证据；缺少现场数据时保留不确定性。

scenes.title: 03 / 设计与代码复评
scenes.body: review 审查当前阶段设计；crosscheck 对已完成工单做独立、多轮复评。
scenes.note: 多模型代码审查时先自行切换 Agent/模型。ICODE 不会自动切换模型；crosscheck 不改原工单历史或代码。

scenes.title: 04 / 构建与设备验证
scenes.body: 按需选择动作，让验证记录对应实际执行。
scenes.note: --listen 或 --test 单独使用时检查设备现有版本，不隐式编译或部署；部署必须明确选择。

scenes.title: 05 / 文档与知识交付
scenes.body: 从工程文档到 Word、PPT 和可复用知识，按目标选择交付形式。
scenes.command: 使用 ICODE 为本项目整理一份面向新人的使用文档。
scenes.note: 生成成功不等于视觉验收通过；纯文本模型不能直接检查图片，需保留视觉复核边界。

scenes.title: 06 / 工单管理与续接
scenes.body: 查看状态、待验证事项，或在本地工作台管理和续接工单。
scenes.more:
/icode list
/icode ui
续接已绑定的 ICODE 工单，先核对状态和执行回执，再从中断点继续。
scenes.note: 官网不连接本机 UI，不读取工单；跨会话续接仍保持原授权范围和停止点。

delivery.title: 设计依据
delivery.body: 为什么增加取模、输入限制是什么、审查意见如何处理。计划与定稿随工单保留。

delivery.title: 代码与测试
delivery.body: 变更哪些源码、覆盖哪些边界、运行了哪些命令。执行记录与实际修改对应。

delivery.title: 验证记录
delivery.body: 分别记录构建、部署与测试证据；带上实际版本和结果，不用“已完成”替代数据。

delivery.title: 未验证事项
delivery.body: 若未接入真实目标设备，就明确标为未验证。把后续验证条件与限制一并交付。

zh-CN.flow_title: 六步推进，每一步都有据可查
zh-CN.features_title: 让开发过程不止于一段对话
features: 说目标，不必背命令
点名 ICODE，说清想做什么、不要做什么。宿主 Agent 映射到原步骤，保留停止点和安全门禁。
工单驱动开发与断点续接
设计、代码与复检记录随工单保存。跨会话恢复时，先核对状态、执行回执和未完成事项，再续接已授权范围。
多模型代码审查
先在宿主中自行切换 Agent/模型，再用 /icode crosscheck 复评已完成工单。ICODE 不会自动切换模型；复评多轮独立保存，不改原工单历史或代码。
以证据记录验证
编译、部署、监听、测试显式组合，记录实际结果与证据缺口。仅监听或测试时，不隐式编译与部署。
本地工单工作台
可选 /icode ui 提供本地管理入口，仍通过已有步骤与门禁。不需要为官网上传工单。
适配已有工作方式
在 Claude Code、Codex 或 CodeBuddy 中使用。独立步骤可以换模型；Runtime 和额外模型服务不是自然语言入口的前提。
zh-CN.install_title: 先安装，再在你的项目里开始
zh-CN.terminal_label: 系统终端 · 先预检，再安装
zh-CN.host_label: 安装后 · 在宿主 Agent 的项目会话输入
zh-CN.install_note: 需要已配置的 AI 编码宿主及其模型访问。安装可能下载运行时和可选 MCP 依赖。all 默认安装 Claude Code 与 Codex；检测到 CodeBuddy 配置才追加它，也可单独使用 --client codebuddy。安装默认仅 Claude。
zh-CN.host_note: 重启或重新加载宿主技能；未触发时显式选用技能或输入 /icode。仅在点名 ICODE 或续接已绑定的 ICODE 工单时使用，不接管未指定 ICODE 的普通请求。这些是宿主 Agent 指令，不是系统 shell 命令。
zh-CN.examples_title: 从一句话开始，也可以精确到一步
zh-CN.examples_note: 以下为用法示例，不是本次运行或设备验证证据。执行范围、权限和可用工具仍由原工作流检查。
examples: 使用 ICODE 给这个模块增加重试，先出方案，不改代码。
/icode start 给计算器增加取模功能并补充测试
自行换模型后独立复评
续接已绑定的 ICODE 工单，先核对状态和执行回执，再从中断点继续；保持原范围和停止点。
zh-CN.boundary: 门禁与报告帮助核验，不保证代码没有缺陷。工具缺失、未执行验证和证据不足应明确保留；宿主、模型与真实设备表现需要各自验证。
zh-CN.privacy: 静态官网，无登录、无追踪。不会读取或上传你的 ICODE 工单。

en.title: An AI coding workflow for ticket-based development.
en.description: ICODE brings a ticket-based AI coding workflow to Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy: staged design, code review after switching models yourself, evidence-based verification and resumable work.
en.eyebrow: Open workflow for Claude Code · Codex · CodeBuddy
en.intro: Keep requirements, design decisions, code changes and verification evidence in one ticket workflow. Move from planning to delivery, check state before resuming interrupted work, and manage tickets through a local UI.
en.flow_intro: Set the boundaries, then move forward. Expand a stage to see what goes in, what comes out, and what must be checked before continuing.
en.optional_title: Optional paths, not extra required stages
en.principles_label: How ICODE keeps work within its boundaries
en.illustration_label: Generic illustration · not a live run
en.delivery_title: Deliver code with the reasons to trust it.
en.delivery_note: A hand-written, generic calculator example showing how evidence is organized, not a real ticket or test result. Having a report does not mean a device was verified.

stages.purpose: Turn an idea into a reviewable implementation plan.
stages.checkpoint: Make exclusions and risks explicit. A design-only request stops here.

stages.input: The plan, relevant source and interface contracts.
stages.checkpoint: Ground recommendations in the design or code, not impressions.

stages.purpose: Consolidate review feedback into an implementation basis.
stages.input: Plan, review findings and agreed trade-offs.
stages.checkpoint: Resolve or explicitly retain open questions and scope changes.

stages.purpose: Implement the finalized plan with traceable changes.
stages.input: Final design and the current code baseline.
stages.output: Source changes, tests and actual execution records.
stages.checkpoint: Stay within authorized scope. A plan is not evidence of completion.

stages.purpose: Revisit implementation and related call chains for gaps.
stages.input: Source changes, design decisions and execution records.
stages.checkpoint: Check boundaries, regressions and missing evidence; fix and retest findings.

stages.purpose: Check whether the delivery conclusion has supporting evidence.
stages.input: Design, code changes and available verification evidence.
stages.checkpoint: Separate verified, pending and blocked. A report is not a device test.

paths.title: Optional intake · init / log
paths.body: Organize complex requirements or establish device and source provenance for log analysis. Choose the entry that fits the task.

paths.title: Independent verification · verify
paths.body: Explicitly choose build, deploy, listen or test, independently or in combination. Listening or testing alone uses the installed version; it does not implicitly build or deploy.

paths.title: Advanced optional review · crosscheck
paths.body: Review a completed ticket independently. Switch agents or models yourself; repeated rounds stay separate from original history and code. No automatic model switching.

scenes.title: 01 / Develop & design
scenes.body: Ticket-based development, or just a design. Tell the agent both your goal and where to stop.
scenes.command: Use ICODE to design retries for this module. Stop at the plan; do not change code.
scenes.more:
/icode start Add modulo to the calculator and cover it with tests
/icode plan
scenes.note: start follows the main workflow; plan can run independently. Design-only requests must stop before implementation.

scenes.title: 02 / Logs & diagnosis
scenes.body: Establish the version, time window and evidence source before analyzing an incident.
scenes.command: Use ICODE to analyze this failure log. Find the cause without changing code.
scenes.note: Current source, deployed versions and historical logs are different evidence layers. Keep uncertainty explicit when field data is missing.

scenes.title: 03 / Design & code review
scenes.body: review examines the current design; crosscheck provides repeatable independent review of completed tickets.
scenes.note: For multi-model code review, switch agents or models yourself first. ICODE does not automatically switch models; crosscheck leaves original history and code unchanged.

scenes.title: 04 / Build & device checks
scenes.body: Choose the actions you need and keep records tied to actual execution.
scenes.note: Using --listen or --test alone checks the installed version. It does not implicitly build or deploy; deployment must be selected explicitly.

scenes.title: 05 / Docs & reusable knowledge
scenes.body: Choose project documentation, Word, PPT or reusable knowledge to match your delivery needs.
scenes.command: Use ICODE to write a newcomer-friendly guide for this project.
scenes.note: Successful generation is not visual acceptance. A text-only model cannot inspect images directly; keep visual review limits explicit.

scenes.title: 06 / Manage & resume tickets
scenes.body: Check state and verification debt, or manage and resume tickets in the local workspace.
scenes.more:
/icode list
/icode ui
Resume the bound ICODE ticket: check its state and execution receipts before continuing.
scenes.note: This website does not connect to your local UI or read tickets. Resuming work retains the original scope and stop points.

delivery.title: Design rationale
delivery.body: Why modulo is needed, which inputs are allowed, and how review findings were handled. Plans stay with the ticket.

delivery.title: Code & tests
delivery.body: Which source changed, which boundaries were covered and which commands ran. Execution records match actual changes.

delivery.title: Verification records
delivery.body: Record build, deployment and test evidence separately, with actual versions and results, not just a completed label.

delivery.title: Not verified
delivery.body: Without access to the target device, mark it not verified. Deliver the remaining conditions and limitations alongside the code.

en.flow_title: Six stages. A traceable path forward.
features: Describe the goal
Name ICODE and state the goal and constraints. Your host agent routes to existing steps, preserving stop points and safety gates.
Ticket-based development you can resume
Plans, changes and review records stay with the ticket. Check its state, execution receipts and unfinished work before resuming the authorized scope in another session.
Multi-model code review

Switch agents or models yourself in your host, then run /icode crosscheck on a completed ticket. ICODE does not automatically switch models; repeatable review rounds stay separate from the original ticket history and code.
Verify with evidence
Explicitly combine build, deploy, listen and test, recording actual results and evidence gaps. Listening or testing alone does not implicitly build or deploy.
Manage tickets locally
The optional /icode ui opens a local workspace using existing steps and gates. No tickets need to be uploaded to this website.
Keep your existing host
Use Claude Code, Codex or CodeBuddy. Switch models between stages. Natural-language routing does not require the optional Runtime or a new model service.
en.install_title: Install once. Start in your project.
en.host_label: After installation · your host agent's project session
en.install_note: Bring a configured AI coding host and model access. Installation may download runtimes and optional MCP dependencies. all installs Claude Code and Codex, adding CodeBuddy only when its configuration exists; --client codebuddy selects it explicitly. The default is Claude only.
en.host_note: Restart or reload skills in your host; select the skill explicitly or use /icode if needed. Use it only when you name ICODE or resume a bound ICODE ticket. It does not take over unrelated requests. These are host agent instructions, not shell commands.
en.examples_title: Start with a sentence. Or choose a step.
en.examples_note: Usage examples, not evidence of a completed run or device verification. Existing gates still check scope, permissions and available tools.
examples: Use ICODE to design retries for this module. Stop at the plan; do not change code.
/icode start Add modulo to the calculator and cover it with tests
Resume the bound ICODE ticket: check its state and execution receipts, then continue from the interruption within the original scope and stop point.
en.boundary: Gates and reports support verification; they do not guarantee defect-free code. Missing tools, unperformed checks and evidence gaps must stay explicit. Hosts, models and physical devices require their own validation.
en.privacy: A static website. No login or tracking. Your ICODE tickets are never read or uploaded.

updates.zh-CN: 自然语言入口：点名 ICODE 并描述目标和限制，复用已有命令与门禁。日期为本条公开说明的审阅日期，不是版本发布日期。
updates.en: Natural-language entry: name ICODE and describe your goal and constraints while keeping existing commands and gates. The date is this note's review date, not the release date.
